reason: Upload-only official API (https://www.standvirtual.com/api/doc/): Standvirtual (OLX Group) publishes an APIDoc for its v2 REST API (OAuth2) to manage professional accounts' adverts, images, stats and taxonomy. It manages the account's own adverts (create/update/delete) and has no public listing search, VIN decode or valuation; the automotive vocabulary is read-only (no write verbs), so it is recorded, not served.
